sloka: अगत्वा निश्चयम् राजा तेषाम् उद्धरणम् प्रति ।व्याधिना नर शार्दूल काल धर्मम् उपेयिवान् ॥१-४२-९॥
transliteration: agatvā niścayam rājā teṣām uddharaṇam prati ।vyādhinā nara śārdūla kāla dharmam upeyivān ॥1-42-9॥

translations.english: O Tiger among men king Dilipa was unable to arrive at a conclusion regarding the salvation of his ancestors.He was affected by illness and died.
